zh.place: 半月酒吧 地下室楼梯口

zh: 水声是从吧台后面的地下室传来的。
Theo那句“你觉得我该去吗”，就这么卡在了半截。
什么动静？谁家水管爆了？
Rowan第一个冲过去，一把拉开了地下室的门。
手机电筒一照：楼梯下面全是水，已经漫到第三级台阶了。
水面上漂着几个柠檬，还有一只拖鞋。
老周今晚没来，他的拖鞋先替他游上了。
Nico脑子嗡的一声。下面是一整个月的货，还有老周那几瓶宝贝威士忌。
别慌别慌，先救酒。酒比人贵。
Rowan把袖子一挽，开始挨个点人。
Wren，楼梯口打光，盯着电闸。水要是碰到插座，马上喊。
收到。录音笔开着呢，这期就叫《送别特辑之抗洪抢险》。
我去后门堵沙袋。Mason，Ethan，你俩把那两桶生啤抬上来。
Mason和Ethan同时一愣，对视半秒，又同时把头扭开。
我膝盖不行。让他一个人抬。
刚才非要冒雨走回家的时候，你膝盖挺行的。
一桶五十多斤。一个人抬，明天我在急诊等他。两个人，现在，去。
两个人谁都没吭声，一前一后下了楼梯。
Nico，Theo，最里面那堆纸箱，纸巾和杯垫，一泡就废。你俩去。
Rowan说完，看了Theo一眼，又看了Nico一眼，转身走了。

zh.hint: 地下室进水了，Rowan让你和Theo去最里面搬箱子。楼梯又黑又滑，你先下。

opts.t: 跟紧我，下面滑。
then: 遵命。你要是摔了我扶你，我要是摔了你别笑。
Theo踩着Nico的脚印，一步一步跟了下来。

opts.t: Nico把鞋一脱，裤腿一卷，第一个蹚进了水里。
then: 那我也脱——嘶！好凉！这水是冰镇的吧？！
这是半月酒吧，水当然是冰镇的。

opts.t: 你在上面待着吧。明天还要赶飞机呢。
then: 飞机是明天的事。纸箱是现在的事。
说完，他抢在Nico前面下了楼梯。

zh: 地下室又矮又潮，冰凉的水没过了脚踝。
另一头，Mason和Ethan面对面，抬着同一个酒桶。
那你说清楚啊。你不是最爱跟人说清楚吗？比如跟教练。
酒桶在半空晃了一下，差点砸在Mason脚上。
回家说？我们在家一个礼拜没说过一句话了，你忘了？
两人一边吵一边往前走——左、右、左、右，步子居然分毫不差。
Wren在楼梯上打着光，凑近录音笔小声说：
现场观察：两个人吵着架，步子完全一致。这叫什么？老夫老妻。
我押五十，他俩今晚和好。
我押一百，他俩今晚不止和好。
走到楼梯一半，Ethan右腿一软，酒桶猛地往下一沉。

zh.hint: Ethan的伤膝盖撑不住了，酒桶眼看要砸下来。你离得最近。

opts.t: Nico蹚过去，从下面托住了酒桶。
then: Mason看了一眼Ethan的膝盖，默默把桶往自己那边挪了挪。
Ethan发现了。他也什么都没说。

opts.t: Ethan，重心放左腿，右腿别使劲。
then: 全世界都知道。就你自己装不知道。
Ethan瞪了他一眼，可还是把重心换到了左腿。

opts.t: 你俩要是把桶摔了，酒钱从你们的友谊里扣。
then: 那正好，没什么可扣的了。
Ethan愣住了。两人谁也没再说话，一口气把桶抬上了楼。
哎哟，Mason说了句人话。今晚值了。

zh: 酒桶上去了。地下室最里面，只剩Nico和Theo两个人。
这箱写着“杯垫”，怎么比我行李箱还沉？
哦对，我行李箱还没收完。我妈说我出门从来不带袜子。
Nico笑了一下，没接话。行李箱、纽约、五年——他尽量不去想。
Theo把纸箱递过来，手却停在半空，没松开。
楼上那句话，我还没问完。
说真的。你觉得，我该去吗？
天花板在滴水。楼上的吵闹声，忽然听着好远。
Nico心里一紧。五年了，Theo第一次这么认真地问他。

zh.hint: Theo在问你：他到底该不该去纽约，一去五年。你这句话怎么说，他会记很久。

opts.t: 去吧。这是你等了好多年的机会。
then: Theo看着他，好一会儿没说话。
我就是想听你说一句。别人说的都不算。
Theo笑了，可那个笑看着有点累。

opts.t: ……你要是不想去，没人会怪你。
then: Theo手一抖，纸箱“扑通”掉进了水里。
他问得很轻。电筒光晃着，Nico看不清他的脸。

opts.t: 去啊，干嘛不去？你走了，终于没人跟我抢着买单了。
then: Theo低头把纸箱往上托了托，没再看Nico。
地下室突然安静得只剩下水声。
到了纽约，第一张明信片寄给你。你不回，我就寄第二张、第三张，寄到你烦为止。
他是笑着说的。可转身的时候，他用袖子飞快地擦了一下脸。
Theo弯腰把纸箱从水里捞起来，半天没直起身。
你刚才那句话……别再说一遍。
电筒光里，他的耳朵红透了。
else: Nico，你每次都这样。一到要紧的时候，就开玩笑。
Theo抱着纸箱走到另一头的货架，背对着他。
Nico张了张嘴。玩笑是他自己开的，现在却一点都不好笑。

zh: 就在这时，头顶一根水管“噗”地爆开，正好浇了Theo一身。
我收回刚才那句话。水比酒贵。
Theo从头湿到脚，衬衫贴在身上，头发一直往下滴水。
阿嚏！完了。明天带着感冒飞十四个小时……
谁在打喷嚏？Theo？上来换衣服！感冒了你还上什么台！
我拿什么换？我衣服全在家里的行李箱里。
Nico想起来：吧台下面，放着他自己那件灰色卫衣。

zh.hint: Theo浑身湿透，冻得直哆嗦，明天还要飞十四个小时。你那件灰卫衣就在吧台下面。

coffee: Nico跑上楼冲了杯热咖啡，塞到他手里。
半夜给我喝咖啡？你是不想让我睡了吧。
Theo嘴上嫌弃，两只手却捧着杯子不撒手。
flower: Nico从吧台花瓶里抽了一枝玫瑰，递给他。
我冻成这样，你给我一枝花？
hoodie: Nico从吧台下面翻出自己的灰卫衣，扔给了他。
Theo套上，袖子长出一截。他低头闻了闻领口。
有你的味道。柠檬味的。……我穿走了啊，不还了。
letter: Nico从收银台撕了张便签，写了三个字塞给他：别感冒。
就三个字？你这信也写得太省了。
Theo嘴上嫌弃，却把便签折好，塞进了湿衬衫的口袋。
ring: Nico从抽屉里翻出一个塑料玩具戒指，万圣节剩下的。
这是……求婚？在漏水的地下室？
行，我先戴着。答不答应，回来再说。

skip: 谢了。毛巾也行，至少不用穿着湿衣服上飞机。

zh: Theo往Nico这边挪了一步，想躲开头顶的水。
过道太窄，他这一步，正好停在Nico面前。
两束电筒光挤在一起。近到能听见对方的呼吸。
哎哎哎！别动！我手机上心跳测试正开着呢！
Nico，你上。看你能不能让他心跳过150。
这是什么奇怪的抗洪项目？

zh.hint: Theo就站在你面前，近得能看清他睫毛上的水珠。Wren在楼梯上喊：让他心跳过150，你就赢。
win: 一百五十二！Theo，你心跳比Nico还快！
Rowan！人冻着了，心跳是变快还是变慢？
Theo张了张嘴，没反驳出来。耳朵一下子红到了脖子。
lose: Theo先往后退了一步，后背撞上了货架。
我是演员，心跳我能控制。专业的。
你控制个鬼，你刚才明明——
搬箱子！搬箱子！再不搬，杯垫都要孵出小鱼了！
skip: 不测。测出来多少我都不认。

zh: Rowan从楼梯口探头看了一眼，又把头缩了回去。
行，我什么都没看见。你们俩继续。

zh.hint: Rowan那句话说得怪怪的。Theo转头看着你，等你解释。

opts.t: 他意思是让你别偷懒。
then: 我偷懒？我一个人搬了三箱！
一箱半。别看我，那半箱也算。

opts.t: Nico假装没听见，弯腰去搬下一个箱子。
then: 装。你一耳朵红，我就知道你听见了。

opts.t: 你问他啊，他是你室友。
then: 他最近老这样。话说一半，剩下一半让我自己猜。

zh: Wren举着手机，从楼梯上探下身子。
这个光，这个水……播客封面就它了。

zh.cap: 周五 23:32 · 地下室，水没过脚踝
zh.prompt: Dim flooded bar basement at night, ankle-deep dark water reflecting two phone flashlight beams, cardboard boxes stacked on metal shelves, wooden stairs in the background. Two adult men around thirty stand close together in the water. One in front has damp dark hair and an oversized gray hoodie over a soaked shirt, glancing back over his shoulder toward the camera with a small smile. The other, with short black hair and rolled-up jeans, holds a box and looks at him. Warm handheld light, cinematic, candid, no text.
then: 完美。标题我都想好了：《他明天就走了》。
Nico伸手就去抢手机，Wren把手举得老高。
skip: 那就是天意，不让我留证据。

zh: 楼上，Rowan用沙袋堵住了后门，水总算不往里灌了。
搞定了？我能坐下了吗？我膝盖在骂人。
Mason没说话，把一个空酒箱翻过来，推到Ethan身后。
Ethan看看箱子，又看看Mason，坐下了。
地下室里，Nico和Theo还站在水里，谁都没先上去。
拿到这个角色那天，我第一个想打电话告诉的人，是你。

zh.hint: Theo说他拿到角色那天，第一个想告诉的人是你，可最后没打这个电话。

opts.t: 为什么没打？
then: 怕你在电话里说一句“恭喜”。
可我也不知道，我到底想听你说什么。
Nico张了张嘴，什么都没说出来。

opts.t: Nico手里的电筒一晃，光正好打在Theo脸上。
then: Theo抬手挡光，笑了。可他没把话收回去。

opts.t: 现在说也不晚。恭喜你啊，Theo。
then: Nico心里一酸。他好像说错话了，可又不知道错在哪。

zh: Theo深吸一口气，把电筒放低，抬头看着他。

zh.title: 全店停电
zh.txt: 啪的一声，整个半月酒吧瞬间黑透了。

zh: 冰柜停了，音响停了。地下室里伸手不见五指。
电闸！Wren，不是让你盯着电闸吗！
都别动！站在原地，谁也别碰水！
Theo那半句话，又一次断在了半空。
一片漆黑里，一只手摸索过来，一把抓住了Nico的手腕。
抓得很紧。那只手是冰的，在发抖。
en: The noise is coming from the basement behind the bar.
Theo's question — "do you think I should go?" — is left hanging.
What was that? Somebody's pipe burst?
Rowan gets there first and yanks the basement door open.
Phone flashlights sweep down: water everywhere, already up to the third step.
A few lemons bob by. And one slipper.
Zhou skipped the party, but his slipper showed up for a swim.
Nico's mind goes blank. A whole month of stock is down there — plus Zhou's precious whiskey.
Don't panic. Save the booze first. Booze costs more than people.
Rowan rolls up his sleeves and starts pointing.
Wren, light on the stairs, eyes on the breaker. Water gets near an outlet, you yell.
Copy. Recorder's rolling. This episode is now "Farewell Special: Flood Edition."
I'll sandbag the back door. Mason, Ethan — bring up those two kegs.
Mason and Ethan both freeze, lock eyes for half a second, and look away at the exact same time.
My knee's shot. Let him do it alone.
Your knee was fine when you wanted to walk home through a hurricane.
That keg's over a hundred pounds. One guy lifts it, I see him in the ER tomorrow. Two guys. Now. Go.
Neither says a word. They head down the stairs, one behind the other.
Nico, Theo — the boxes in the very back. Napkins and coasters. Once they're wet, they're garbage. That's you two.
Rowan glances at Theo, then at Nico, and walks off.
Theo raises an eyebrow at Nico.

en.hint: The basement's flooding, and Rowan sent you and Theo to the back. The stairs are dark and slippery. You go first.

opts.t: Stay close. It's slippery.
then: Yes sir. If you fall, I'll catch you. If I fall, no laughing.
Theo follows him down, stepping exactly where Nico steps.

opts.t: Nico kicks off his shoes, rolls up his jeans, and wades in first.
then: Fine, me too — oh God! Cold! Is this water on ice?!
It's the Halfmoon, babe. Everything's served chilled.

opts.t: You stay up here. You've got a flight to catch.
then: The flight's tomorrow's problem. The boxes are right now.
And he heads down the stairs ahead of Nico.

en: The basement is low and damp. Ice-cold water up past their ankles.
At the other end, Mason and Ethan are face to face, lifting the same keg.
...We're facing each other. Think about it.
Then be clear. You love being clear, right? Like with Coach.
The keg swings and nearly lands on Mason's foot.
Lift the keg. We'll talk about the rest at home.
Talk at home? We haven't said one word at home all week. Remember?
They keep fighting, and keep walking — left, right, left, right. Perfectly in step.
Up on the stairs, Wren holds the light and whispers into her recorder:
Field notes: they're fighting, and they're in perfect step. You know what that's called? An old married couple.
Mason and Ethan, in unison: "Shut up!"
Fifty bucks says they make up tonight.
A hundred says they do more than make up.
Halfway up the stairs, Ethan's right leg buckles. The keg drops hard.

en.hint: Ethan's bad knee just gave out, and the keg's about to come down. You're the closest.

opts.t: Nico splashes over and braces the keg from below.
then: Mason glances at Ethan's knee and quietly shifts the weight to his own side.
Ethan notices. He doesn't say anything either.
Nico, one good-guy point. Put it on the tab.

opts.t: Ethan, weight on your left. Don't push with the right.
then: How do you know it's the right one?
Everyone knows. You're the only one pretending you don't.
Ethan glares at him — but shifts his weight to the left.

opts.t: Drop that keg and I'm taking it out of your friendship.
then: Ethan freezes. Neither says another word. They haul the keg up in one go.
Whoa, Mason said a human sentence. Tonight was worth it.

en: The kegs are up. In the back of the basement, it's just Nico and Theo.
Theo picks up a box and weighs it.
This says "coasters." Why is it heavier than my suitcase?
Oh right, I haven't finished packing. My mom says I never pack socks.
Nico laughs a little and says nothing. Suitcase. New York. Five years. He tries not to think about it.
Theo hands him the box — and doesn't let go.
Upstairs. I didn't get to finish.
Five years, Nico. Not five months.
For real. Do you think I should go?
The ceiling drips. The noise upstairs suddenly sounds very far away.
Nico's chest tightens. Five years, and Theo has never asked him anything this seriously.

en.hint: Theo is asking you if he should go to New York — for five years. Whatever you say, he'll remember it for a long time.

opts.t: Go. You've waited years for this.
then: Theo looks at him and doesn't say anything for a while.
I just wanted to hear it from you. Nobody else's answer counts.
Theo smiles. It looks a little tired.

opts.t: ...If you don't want to go, nobody's gonna blame you.
then: Theo's hands jerk. The box drops into the water with a splash.
...What about you? You wouldn't blame me?
He asks it quietly. The flashlight wobbles. Nico can't see his face.

opts.t: Go, obviously. Once you're gone, nobody'll fight me for the check.
then: Theo hoists the box higher and stops looking at Nico.
Suddenly the only sound in the basement is the water.
First postcard from New York goes to you. You don't write back, I send a second, a third — until you're sick of me.
He says it with a grin. But when he turns away, he wipes his face fast with his sleeve.
Theo bends to fish the box out of the water and stays down a long time.
What you just said... don't say it again.
I'm scared I'll take it seriously.
In the flashlight beam, his ears are bright red.
else: Nico, you always do this. The second it matters, you make a joke.
Theo carries the box to the far shelf and keeps his back to him.
Nico opens his mouth. He's the one who made the joke. It isn't funny anymore.

en: Right then a pipe overhead bursts — pfft — and drenches Theo.
I take it back. Water costs more than booze.
Theo's soaked head to toe. His shirt is plastered to him, his hair dripping.
Theo sneezes three times in a row.
Achoo! Great. Fourteen hours on a plane with a cold...
Who's sneezing? Theo? Get up here and change! You can't go onstage sick!
Change into what? All my clothes are in my suitcase at home.
Nico remembers: his own gray hoodie is stashed under the bar.

en.hint: Theo's soaked and shivering, with a fourteen-hour flight tomorrow. Your gray hoodie is right under the bar.

coffee: Nico runs upstairs, makes a hot coffee, and shoves it into his hands.
Coffee at midnight? You trying to keep me up all night?
He complains — but holds the cup in both hands and won't let go.
flower: Nico pulls a rose from the vase on the bar and hands it to him.
I'm freezing to death and you give me a flower?
hoodie: Nico digs his gray hoodie out from under the bar and tosses it to him.
Theo pulls it on. The sleeves are too long. He sniffs the collar.
Smells like you. Like lemons. ...I'm taking this. Not giving it back.
letter: Nico tears a sticky note off the register, writes two words, and hands it over: Don't. Sneeze.
Two words? Real generous with the ink there.
But he folds it up and tucks it into his wet shirt pocket.
ring: Nico digs a plastic toy ring out of a drawer, left over from Halloween.
Is this... a proposal? In a flooded basement?
Okay, I'll wear it for now. I'll give you my answer when I'm back.

skip: Nico tosses him a dry towel.
Thanks. Towel works. At least I won't board the plane dripping.

en: Theo takes a step toward Nico to get out from under the leak.
The aisle's too narrow. One step, and he's right in front of Nico.
Two flashlight beams squeezed together. Close enough to hear each other breathe.
Hey hey hey! Freeze! I've got the heartbeat test open on my phone!
Nico, you're up. Let's see if you can get him past 150.
What kind of flood relief is this?

en.hint: Theo's right in front of you — close enough to see water on his eyelashes. Wren yells from the stairs: get his heart past 150 and you win.
win: One fifty-two! Theo, your heart's going faster than Nico's!
Rowan! When you're cold, does your heart rate go up or down?
Theo opens his mouth. No comeback. He goes red from his ears down to his neck.
lose: Theo steps back first and bumps into the shelf.
I'm an actor. I can control my heart rate. Professional.
Control my foot, you were literally just—
Boxes! Boxes! Any longer and the coasters are gonna hatch fish!
skip: Not doing it. Whatever number comes up, I'm not owning it.

en: Rowan pokes his head down the stairs, takes one look, and pulls back.
Okay. I saw nothing. Carry on, you two.

en.hint: Rowan's comment was weird. Theo turns to you, waiting for an explanation.

opts.t: He means stop slacking.
then: Slacking? I carried three boxes by myself!
One and a half. Don't look at me like that, the half counts.

opts.t: Nico pretends he didn't hear and bends down for the next box.
then: Theo grins and bends down next to him.
Nice try. Your ears go red when you hear something.

opts.t: Ask him. He's your roommate.
then: He's been like that lately. Says half a thing and makes me guess the rest.

en: Wren leans down over the stair rail, phone up.
This light, this water... That's my podcast cover.
I'm soaking wet and you want a photo?
Soaking wet is the point. Quick, Theo, look back.

en.prompt: Dim flooded bar basement at night, ankle-deep dark water reflecting two phone flashlight beams, cardboard boxes stacked on metal shelves, wooden stairs in the background. Two adult men around thirty stand close together in the water. One in front has damp dark hair and an oversized gray hoodie over a soaked shirt, glancing back over his shoulder toward the camera with a small smile. The other, with short black hair and rolled-up jeans, holds a box and looks at him. Warm handheld light, cinematic, candid, no text.
then: Perfect. I already have the title: "He Leaves Tomorrow."
Nico lunges for the phone. Wren holds it way over her head.
Don't delete it. Send me one.
skip: Ugh, my hand shook. It's all blurry.
Guess the universe doesn't want evidence.

en: Upstairs, Rowan's sandbagged the back door. The water finally stops coming in.
Are we done? Can I sit? My knee is cursing at me.
Mason says nothing. He flips over an empty crate and slides it behind Ethan.
Ethan looks at the crate, then at Mason. He sits.
He got you a seat, you know.
Down in the basement, Nico and Theo are still standing in the water. Neither moves first.
Nico. Can I tell you something?
The day I got the part, the first person I wanted to call was you.

en.hint: Theo just said that when he got the part, you were the first person he wanted to call — but he never did.

opts.t: Why didn't you?
then: I was scared you'd just say "congrats."
But I don't even know what I wanted you to say instead.
Nico opens his mouth. Nothing comes out.

opts.t: Nico's flashlight jerks and lands right on Theo's face.
then: Hey, hey — is this an interrogation?
Theo shields his eyes and laughs. But he doesn't take it back.

opts.t: It's not too late. Congrats, Theo.
then: Theo looks down and lets out a short laugh.
Nico feels a pang. He said the wrong thing, somehow. He just doesn't know what.

en: Theo takes a deep breath, lowers his flashlight, and looks right at him.
Nico, honestly, I don't want to—

en.title: Blackout
en.txt: With a snap, the whole Halfmoon goes pitch black.

en: The coolers die. The music dies. The basement is so dark you can't see your own hand.
Ow — who stepped on my foot?!
The breaker! Wren, weren't you supposed to watch the breaker?!
Nobody move! Stay where you are, and stay out of the water!
Theo's sentence is cut off — again.
In the pitch dark, a hand gropes toward him — and grabs Nico's wrist.
The grip is tight. The hand is ice-cold, and it's shaking.
